title: Qualify isolated exact Math NuGet distribution and package consumer
commitMessage: feat: qualify standalone exact Math NuGet consumer and package provenance

contribution.summary: Build the three exact Math local NuGet packages, inspect every nuspec and artifact hash, and run a package-reference-only .NET consumer restoring solely from a bounded local feed. Qualify exact arithmetic, inch/IEC conversion, tolerance, parsing, temperatures, owner source rights and deliberate historical divergence.
contribution.value: Demonstrates genuinely isolated AURA-free reuse of Math's three independently compiled packages through a reproducible local-only NuGet consumer and durable dependency/hash provenance rather than project-reference smoke tests.
debtChanges: The three nupkg binaries remain under ignored disposable build outputs; durable source recipe and observed hashes are committed, but no binary is published to a public or sibling feed.
Artifact SHA-256 values identify the exact attempt's packages, not bit-for-bit reproducibility across SDK/toolchain environments or a third-party code-signing audit.

AURA's legacy culture-priority resolver and Math's explicit unit profiles intentionally differ under the accepted M0 decision; external AURA adoption and any historical defect resolution need their own review.
contribution.nextAction: Prepare the M1-W03-C02 AURA adoption dossier, explicit external consumer and rollback matrix, and local M1 release gate, without modifying sibling repositories or claiming adoption before it is verified.

achievements.achievement: Before packaging, a package-only .NET consumer cannot restore the absent exact Math packages from the explicitly cleared, local-only NuGet feed. Its failure is observed without contacting remote sources.

Build and inspect three standalone exact Math NuGet packages; install a source-controlled package-only console consumer with local-only feed configuration and exact arithmetic, conversion, comparison, parser and temperature checks.

All three packages contain expected net10.0 assemblies, NuGet identities and allowed Math dependencies; locked Math build, full quantities tests, foundation chain and local-only consumer restore/build/run pass.

The full isolated mathematical package-consumption contract completes from observed absence through local feed production, NuGet-only restore and independently executed exact calculation and conversion oracles.

Before local build publication, the distribution rights/hashes receipt and package guidance are absent. Provenance requirements are recognized independently of the consumer's initial missing-package RED.

Inspect every generated nupkg manifest and SHA-256, verify the owner-authorized proprietary source rights and publish a bounded local-only distribution recipe documenting historical source divergences and no external package publication.

Verify the package dependency whitelist, artifact assembly contents, recorded hashes, owner attestation and exact consumer results; retain explicit differences from AURA culture-priority resolution without changing inherited mathematical oracles.
The distribution provenance and boundary contract completes with executable local feed evidence, rights notices, hashes, explicitly limited publication scope and accepted AURA divergence policy.

The parity and isolated consumption chunk completes with three local NuGet package artifacts, hash/dependency receipts, a reproducible source-controlled package-only consumer, exact independent smoke oracles and no sibling repository writes.
